name: Lost Soul
summary: A guttering wisp of a person who forgot their own name. Alone it is a cold draft and a sob in the dark; in hundreds it is a haunting.
tactics: Drifts toward warmth and light, brushing the living with numbing fingers, then scatters at the first loud noise.
habitat: battlefields, shipwrecks, abandoned hospitals
weakness: Speaking its forgotten name lays it to rest instantly

name: Ghoul
summary: A grave-robbing eater of the dead with yellow nails and a mouth that never stops chewing. Its filthy claws carry a numbing rot that locks muscles solid.
tactics: Packs lurk below graveyards and rush lone mourners, paralyzing them with claws and dragging them underground to eat later.
habitat: catacombs, cemetery warrens, charnel pits
weakness: Fire and sunlight; holy symbols send it cringing into the dark

powers.name: Paralytic Rot
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed

name: Ghast
summary: A ghoul that has eaten something holy and grown cunning and foul. A charnel stench rolls off it thick enough to drop a strong man retching to his knees.
tactics: Leads ghoul packs from the rear, waits for its stench to stagger prey, then strikes the weakest with paralyzing claws.
habitat: plague pits, ossuaries, sewers below old churches
weakness: Sunlight; strong incense or vinegar-soaked cloth blocks its stench

powers.name: Paralytic Rot
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed

name: Wight
summary: A dead chieftain who would not give up his crown, his eyes two pinpricks of grave-light. His touch steals the heat and breath from the living, and the barrow-dead rise when he calls.
tactics: Freezes intruders with its dread stare, raises skeletal guards, then drains the strongest foe with a cold gauntlet.
habitat: barrow mounds, ancient tombs, haunted moors
weakness: Sunlight; returning its stolen grave-goods unbinds it

powers.name: Dread Stare
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed (grave-chill terror)

alternates.name: Life-Draining Touch
alternates.detail: Stamina; resisted by Fortitude

name: Wraith
summary: A hate so old it forgot it was ever a person, now just a tattered silhouette with ember eyes. What it touches withers, and those it slays rise as lesser shades in its train.
tactics: Glides through walls to strike from behind, siphoning life; when cornered it unleashes a wail of unlight and fades into shadow.
habitat: ruined keeps, lightless caverns, cursed battlefields
weakness: Sunlight robs it of all power; blessed or silvered weapons can touch it

powers.name: Wail of Unlight
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (despair)

alternates.name: Soul-Siphon
alternates.detail: Stamina; resisted by Fortitude

name: Plague Zombie Horde
summary: Not the slow dead of the old stories: these are fresh, feverish and fast, sprinting on broken ankles. Every bite spreads the plague, and every victim joins the run.
tactics: Swarms in howling waves, piling onto whoever falls; the horde grows with every round a hero spends surrounded.
habitat: quarantined cities, overrun hospitals, highway pileups
weakness: Destroying the brain; they are blind to anyone smeared in their own gore

powers.name: Infectious Bite
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Transformed (rises as a plague zombie)

name: Drowned Dead
summary: Bloated, weed-wrapped sailors who walk up out of the surf at low tide, reeking of brine. They want company at the bottom of the sea.
tactics: Rise around boats and piers in silence, seize anyone near the edge and drag them under, holding on until the bubbles stop.
habitat: shipwrecks, flooded towns, cold harbors
weakness: They cannot leave the water's edge for long; salt fire dries them to husks

powers.name: Drag to the Deep
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (drowning)

name: Revenant
summary: A murdered soul dragged back into its own rotting body by pure, unfinished vengeance. It always knows where its killer is, and it simply does not stop.
tactics: Walks straight through everything between it and its murderer; it ignores bystanders unless they get in the way, and stands back up after every defeat.
habitat: wherever its killer hides
weakness: Its killer brought to justice (or dead) ends it at once; fire only slows it

powers.name: Accusing Stare

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: only those complicit in its death

powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Paralyzed (guilt)

powers.name: Hunter of the Guilty
powers.detail: Detect Murderer (accurate, extended, any distance), Tracking

name: Vampire Bride
summary: One of a vampire lord's chosen consorts, all moonlit lace and sharp smiles. Her song pulls victims out of bed and through the window; her kiss leaves them pale and willing.
tactics: Sings from the dark to draw victims into the open, then drains them with a kiss; she fights in threes with her sisters and retreats as mist.
habitat: gothic manors, crypts, moonlit balconies
weakness: Sunlight, a stake through the heart, garlic and running water

powers.name: Siren Song
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled

name: Headless Horseman
summary: A hessian trooper whose head was taken by a cannonball, now riding forever on a black steed with a burning jack-o'-lantern in his fist. He hunts the head he lost, and anyone's will do.
tactics: Charges out of the fog, hurls blazing pumpkins, then rides past swinging a sabre at necks. He breaks off at running water.
habitat: hollow roads, covered bridges, autumn woods
weakness: Cannot cross running water or a church bridge; returning his skull lays him to rest

name: Death Knight
summary: A fallen paladin bound in his own blackened plate, his oath broken and his soul nailed to his armor. Where he rides, banners rot and courage curdles.
tactics: Wades into melee behind an aura of dread, cleaving through ranks, and drops a hellfire comet on any archers hanging back.
habitat: ruined chapels, conquered fortresses, endless battlefields
weakness: His broken oath: a true knight's sincere forgiveness shatters his armor's binding

name: Vampire Lord
summary: Centuries old, aristocratic and patient, a predator who owns the police chief, the bishop and the bank. He becomes mist, bats or wolf as he pleases, and the night itself answers when he calls.
tactics: Prefers proxies and puppets; in person he mesmerizes the strongest hero, sets wolves and bats on the rest, and drinks deep when someone is pinned.
habitat: castles, penthouses, old-money estates
weakness: Sunlight, a wooden stake, his native soil; he cannot enter a home uninvited

powers.name: Predator Senses
powers.detail: Darkvision, Scent, Acute Hearing, Detect Blood

name: Mummy Lord
summary: A god-king sealed with his treasures and his curse, who wakes when the tomb is opened. Sand obeys him, scarabs serve him, and his touch spreads a rot that turns flesh to dust.
tactics: Fixes intruders with a paralyzing glare, calls a sandstorm to blind them, and lets his rotting touch finish whoever is still standing.
habitat: sealed pyramids, museum vaults, desert necropolises
weakness: Fire; while his canopic jars survive he returns, so smash them

powers.name: Gaze of the Pharaoh
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed (dread)

alternates.name: Mummy Rot
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Incapacitated (crumbles to dust)

name: Bone Colossus
summary: A cathedral-tall giant knitted from the bones of an entire war cemetery, its ribcage full of screaming prisoners. It shambles through walls and grows larger with every grave it walks over.
tactics: Sweeps crowds with a scything arm of femurs, scoops the strongest foe into its ribcage cell, and absorbs fresh corpses to rebuild itself.
habitat: mass graves, war-torn cities, necromancer citadels
weakness: The necromantic seal on its skull; consecrated ground makes its bones fall apart

powers.name: Ribcage Prison
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained

name: Grave-Wyrm
summary: An ancient dragon that refused death, its wings now tattered sails over a skeleton of green-black bone. Its breath does not burn; it ends, aging all it touches to dust in a heartbeat.
tactics: Opens from the sky with a cone of grave-breath, terrifies the survivors with its presence, then lands to crush whatever still moves.
habitat: dead mountains, sunken necropolises, the hoards of fallen kingdoms
weakness: Its soul-gem hidden in the hoard; consecrated ground burns its bones

powers.name: Dread Presence
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (terror)

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: while its soul-gem rests in its hoard

powers.name: Wyrm Senses
powers.detail: Darkvision, Detect Life, Detect Magic, Extended Vision

name: Poltergeist
summary: A noisy, invisible tantrum of a ghost that stacks chairs, slams doors and throws the kitchen knives. Usually it haunts a family, and usually it is angry at one person in particular.
tactics: Never shows itself; it hurls furniture and crockery from across the room, kills the lights, and shrieks inside the walls.
habitat: suburban houses, orphanages, old schools
weakness: Revealing the grudge that binds it; a medium's séance can force it visible

alternates.name: Shriek in the Walls
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled (terror)

alternates.name: Lights Out
alternates.detail: Electrical devices

name: Imp
summary: A cat-sized devil with bat wings, a barbed tail and a contract in its pocket. It runs errands for warlocks, spies on rivals, and lies about everything for fun.
tactics: Stays airborne and out of reach, pelting foes with sparks of hellfire and stinging anyone who grabs for it, then vanishes and reappears as a rat or raven.
habitat: warlock towers, infernal embassies, attics
weakness: Its true name, which binds it to obey; holy water burns like acid

alternates.name: Venom Sting
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted (venom)

name: Whisper-Fiend
summary: A grinning, toad-skinned tempter that rides unseen on a mortal's shoulder, whispering every petty cruelty into their ear. It never lies outright; it just suggests.
tactics: Avoids fighting entirely; it turns allies against each other with whispered suggestions and flees invisibly when discovered.
habitat: courts, boardrooms, monasteries, wherever there is a soul to rot
weakness: Spoken aloud, its whispers lose all power; a sincere confession drives it off

powers.name: Corrupting Whisper
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled

name: Demon Hound Pack
summary: Hairless, red-eyed hounds of the pit that hunt in perfect silence until the moment they all howl at once. Damned souls who try to escape their contracts hear that howl last.
tactics: Circles and flanks with uncanny coordination, howls to break morale, and drags down whoever runs.
habitat: the borderlands of Hell, crossroads at midnight
weakness: Cannot cross an unbroken line of salt; consecrated ground burns their paws

name: Possessing Spirit
summary: A bodiless demon that needs a host the way a fire needs wood. Once inside, it wears its victim like a coat, speaking in their voice while their eyes go black.
tactics: Leaps into the most dangerous hero in the room and turns them on their friends; driven out, it simply looks for the next body.
habitat: anywhere a door was opened: ouija boards, cursed objects, old asylums
weakness: Exorcism rites, its true name, cold iron; it cannot possess the truly fearless

powers.name: Possession
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; the spirit rides the host body

alternates.name: Night Terrors
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (terror)

name: Succubus / Incubus
summary: A demon of desire that wears the face you most want to see. It walks into dreams, bargains for souls in the currency of longing, and kisses the life out of the foolish.
tactics: Charms the strongest foe into defending it, slips away into a sleeper's dreams when hurt, and drains anyone it can hold close.
habitat: nightclubs, palaces, dreams
weakness: A true love's name spoken aloud breaks its charms; holy symbols scald it

alternates.name: Draining Kiss
alternates.detail: Stamina; resisted by Fortitude

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: only into the dreams of a sleeper

name: Hell Knight
summary: A devil-officer in red-hot plate that drips slag, carrying a burning blade and a coil of barbed chain. They serve as Hell's police, collecting debts that come due.
tactics: Lashes chains to bind a target, drags them into range of the burning blade, and calls the rest of the squad if the collection gets difficult.
habitat: infernal fortresses, crossroads, the homes of defaulting contract-signers
weakness: A contract proven void; holy weapons ignore its armor

powers.name: Chains of Torment
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained

name: Gluttony Demon
summary: A sagging hill of grey flesh that is mostly mouth, and the mouth is mostly teeth. It eats, digests and keeps eating, and its belly gurgles with the screams of the half-swallowed.
tactics: Lurches forward to engulf the nearest foe whole, digests them while it fights, and sprays a geyser of bile at anyone trying to cut them free.
habitat: banquet halls, landfills, the lower circles
weakness: Feed it something holy and it vomits up everything it has swallowed

powers.name: Engulf
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained (swallowed)

name: Soul-Eater
summary: A long-limbed demon with a lamprey maw where its face should be, which feeds on the soul rather than the flesh. Those it devours are left breathing, smiling and utterly empty.
tactics: Hunts the strongest-willed hero first, latching on to devour their mind, and blasts crowds with a cone of soulfire that leaves them blank and drooling.
habitat: battlefields after the fighting, hospices, the void between hells
weakness: A soul freely offered in another's place chokes it; mirrors show it its own emptiness

powers.name: Devour Soul
powers.detail: Intellect, Awareness and Presence; resisted by Will

alternates.name: Soulfire Maw
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (soul-blasted)

powers.name: Soul-Sight
powers.detail: Detect Souls (accurate, ranged), Darkvision, See Invisible

name: War Demon
summary: A four-armed demon general armored in the fused shields of the armies it has broken. Its roar is the sound of every battle cry ever silenced, and it laughs as it fights.
tactics: Leads from the front with four blades, roars to rout the weak, and summons its damned host to swamp heroes who try to hold a line.
habitat: eternal battlefields, conquered cities, wherever war is about to break out
weakness: Peace: a true truce sworn in its presence banishes it until the next war

powers.name: Battle-Roar
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (terror)

name: Brimstone Sovereign
summary: A lord of the Ninth Furnace, horned in black iron and crowned in a ring of perpetual flame, who keeps a ledger of every soul ever sold. Kings have knelt to it; so have gods.
tactics: Opens with bargains and threats, binds a hero's soul with a brand of damnation, lashes with its hellfire whip and calls legions of hell knights to finish the job.
habitat: the Ninth Furnace; summoning circles of the very foolish
weakness: Its own contracts: find the loophole and it is bound by its word; blessed relics burn it

alternates.name: Brand of Damnation
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Compelled, Controlled (soul-bound)

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: unless slain within its own furnace

powers.name: Infernal Senses
powers.detail: Darkvision, Detect Souls (accurate, extended), See Invisible

name: Brine-Spawn Raider
summary: Bulging-eyed, gill-slit fish-folk who come ashore on moonless nights to take tribute from fishing towns that made a bargain with the deep. Some of them still remember being human.
tactics: Wades out of the surf in croaking packs, spears anyone on the docks, and drags captives back into the waves.
habitat: drowned reefs, decaying harbor towns, sea caves
weakness: Dry air: they weaken after an hour ashore; the old sigil of the elder stars wards doors

name: Shadow People
summary: Man-shaped holes in the dark, seen at the edge of vision and in the doorway at 3 a.m. They press down on sleepers until breath stops and the heart forgets to beat.
tactics: Gather silently around a sleeping or exhausted target, paralyze them with a touch, and melt into the dark when a light comes on.
habitat: bedrooms, hallways, long-haul truck cabs
weakness: Bright light scatters them; they cannot touch anyone who is fully awake and calm

powers.name: Sleep-Paralysis Touch
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

name: Faceless Man
summary: A tall figure in a black suit with smooth skin where its face should be, always seen in threes. Witnesses who look too long start to forget their own faces.
tactics: Appears where no one is looking, closes in silently, and touches victims to erase their identities; cameras record only static.
habitat: train stations, corporate towers, the backgrounds of photographs
weakness: Spoken names: saying a victim's full name aloud restores them and stalls the Faceless

powers.name: Erase the Face
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Transformed (forgets their own face and name)

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: only to places no one is watching

name: The Thing in the Walls
summary: Something long, pale and jointed in too many places that lives between the drywall and the studs. It has learned to whisper in your mother's voice.
tactics: Mimics familiar voices to lure a victim close to a wall or vent, then a hand bursts through the plaster and drags them inside.
habitat: old houses, apartment blocks, crawlspaces
weakness: Light and open space; it cannot abide a bright, empty room

powers.name: Grasp from the Plaster
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained (dragged into the wall)

powers.name: Familiar Voices
powers.detail: Perfectly mimics voices it has overheard

name: Fungal Brain-Thief
summary: A pinkish, crab-clawed fungus from beyond the outer planets that flies on membrane wings. It surgically removes human brains and keeps them alive in humming metal canisters, for study and for conversation.
tactics: Stuns targets from a distance with a nerve-lash, then retreats to its hidden lab; it disguises itself with wax masks to bargain with the greedy.
habitat: remote hills, abandoned mines, observatories
weakness: Fire: its fungal flesh burns like tinder; its canisters are fragile

powers.name: Nerve-Lash
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

powers.name: Brain Canister
powers.detail: Keeps an extracted brain alive and talking

name: Nightmare Hag
summary: The original mare of nightmare: a withered crone who squats on sleepers' chests and rides them through dreams until dawn. Victims wake exhausted, bruised, and a little older.
tactics: Enters through dreams, weaves terrifying illusions, and pins the weakest dreamer; awake she fights with filthy claws and blinks into the dream-world when hurt.
habitat: dreams, isolated cottages, stables
weakness: A broom across the threshold, cold iron under the pillow; she must answer if asked her name three times

powers.name: Hag-Ride
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Incapacitated

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: only to sleepers or the exhausted

powers.name: Three Faces
powers.detail: Crone, black mare or beautiful maiden

name: The Tall Watcher
summary: Impossibly tall and thin, faceless, in a black suit, standing at the treeline in the background of every photo. You never see it move; it is simply closer each time you look.
tactics: Stalks one victim over days, inflicting paranoia and nosebleeds; when they finally break, its tendrils lift them into the trees.
habitat: forests at the edge of town, playgrounds, abandoned hospitals
weakness: Looking at it is what lets it in: it cannot follow those who refuse to look at it, photograph it or speak of it

powers.name: Watcher Sickness
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (paranoia, nosebleeds)

alternates.name: Tendril Lift
alternates.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained

name: Shuddering Protoplasm
summary: A bubbling, train-sized mass of black jelly studded with hundreds of opening and closing eyes, made long ago as a slave by something older. It mimics the screams of everything it has eaten.
tactics: Rolls over a group to engulf them, sprouts pseudopods to batter the rest, and dissolves anything trapped inside.
habitat: drowned cities, Antarctic ruins, subway tunnels
weakness: Intense cold slows it to a crawl; it fears the sigils its makers used to command it

powers.name: Engulf
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained

powers.name: Echoed Screams
powers.detail: Mimics the voices of those it has eaten

powers.name: A Hundred Eyes
powers.detail: Darkvision, Detect Vibrations, cannot be surprised

name: Star-Spawn of the Sleeping Deep
summary: An octopus-headed, bat-winged mountain of green flesh that seeped down from the stars before the moon was born. It dreams, and its dreams drive whole cities mad.
tactics: Broadcasts madness over miles before it ever arrives, then rises from the sea to sweep ships and buildings with its face-tentacles; it reforms if destroyed.
habitat: sunken non-Euclidean cities, the deep ocean, dreams
weakness: When the stars are wrong it must sleep; a ship rammed through its head disperses it for a time

alternates.name: Dreaming Madness
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (madness)

name: Starveling Wendigo
summary: An elder wendigo that has eaten whole winter camps: a forty-foot skeleton of frostbitten skin and antlers that grows taller with every meal and never, ever stops being hungry. It rides the blizzard.
tactics: Wraps an area in killing cold, whispers hunger into the minds of the lost until they turn on each other, then descends on the wind.
habitat: northern forests in deep winter, frozen lakes
weakness: Fire and warmth; melting its heart of ice is the only way to end it

powers.name: Whisper of Hunger
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Compelled, Transformed (cannibal hunger)

powers.name: Hunter Senses
powers.detail: Scent, Tracking, Low-light Vision, Acute Hearing

name: Doppelganger
summary: A grey, featureless thing that becomes a perfect copy of someone you love, down to their memories and pet names. Seeing your own double is said to mean you will die soon.
tactics: Kills and replaces a trusted person, reads surface thoughts to keep the act up, and strikes with a hidden blade when found out.
habitat: suburbs, offices, the house next door
weakness: Mirrors and still water show its true form; dogs always bark at it

name: Skin-Walker
summary: A witch who paid for power with someone they loved, and now wears animal pelts to become what they wear. It knocks on windows at night and calls your name in your brother's voice.
tactics: Shadows its target for days in animal shapes, wears down the household with corpse-powder curses, then attacks at night with inhuman speed.
habitat: desert highways, isolated ranches, canyon country
weakness: Calling it by its true human name drains its power; ash-tipped weapons pierce it

powers.name: Wear the Skin
powers.detail: Any animal, or any person whose skin it wears

powers.name: Corpse Powder
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Incapacitated (wasting curse)

powers.name: Familiar Voices
powers.detail: Mimics any voice it has heard

powers.name: Beast Senses
powers.detail: Low-light Vision, Scent, Tracking, Acute Hearing

name: The Rake
summary: A hairless, pale, crouching humanoid with long hooked fingers, found at the foot of the bed in the middle of the night, staring. Survivors describe its eyes most of all.
tactics: Waits motionless until noticed, freezes its victim with eye contact, then lunges with raking claws and is gone before the screaming stops.
habitat: suburban bedrooms, woods behind houses, the American northeast
weakness: Bright, sudden light sends it scuttling; it never attacks a group that keeps watch together

powers.name: Bedside Stare
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed (frozen dread)

name: Wererat Swarm
summary: A cursed man who bursts apart into hundreds of squealing, red-eyed rats, then pulls himself back together in an alley a block away. The bite carries the curse.
tactics: Breaks into a gnawing tide to overrun a group, bites the most exposed foe to spread the curse, and reassembles out of reach.
habitat: sewers, tenements, docks
weakness: Silver; a single surviving rat can reform him, so burn them all

alternates.name: Plague Bite
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Transformed (wererat curse)

name: Werebear
summary: A hermit of the deep woods who becomes a ton of muscle and fury when the wilderness is threatened. Most are guardians; the cursed ones are the worst things in the forest.
tactics: Charges straight in, swats down the strongest foe and crushes them in a bear hug while shrugging off wounds.
habitat: old-growth forests, mountain passes
weakness: Silver; honey and an offering of respect can calm a guardian werebear

name: Werewolf Alpha
summary: The ancient source of a lycanthrope bloodline: bigger, smarter and crueler than its brood, able to call every wolf and werewolf for miles with a single howl.
tactics: Opens with a terrifying howl, sends the pack to flank, and personally hunts the leader of the heroes, biting to spread the curse.
habitat: deep forests, highland moors, the city's darkest parks
weakness: Silver; wolfsbane; killing the alpha lifts the curse from its brood

powers.name: Cursed Bite
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Transformed (werewolf)

powers.name: Keen Senses
powers.detail: Low-light Vision, Scent, Tracking, Acute Hearing

name: Stymphalian Flock
summary: Man-eating marsh birds with bronze beaks and razor feathers they shed like arrows. A flock blots out the sun and turns a field into a pincushion.
tactics: Wheels overhead loosing volleys of bronze feathers, then dives on anyone who falls.
habitat: marshes, lakes, abandoned harbors
weakness: The clangor of bronze rattles drives the flock into panicked flight

name: Nemean Lion
summary: A golden lion fallen from the moon whose hide no blade, arrow or club can pierce. It has emptied whole valleys, and it toys with heroes who try their swords on it.
tactics: Lets weapons glance off its hide while it mauls the attacker, pounces from rocks, and roars to scatter the timid.
habitat: mountain caves with two entrances, sun-baked hills
weakness: Its own claws can cut its hide; it can be wrestled and strangled

powers.name: Shaking Roar
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (terror)

name: Cyclops Elder
summary: One of the first forge-giants, who traded half his sight for a glimpse of the future and hammered out thunderbolts for the gods. He knows how you will die, and might tell you, for a price.
tactics: Hurls forged thunderbolts from a distance, then wades in with his anvil-hammer; his foresight means he is almost never surprised.
habitat: volcanic forges, island caves
weakness: His single eye: a blinding strike leaves him helpless; vain about his craftsmanship

name: Cerberus
summary: The three-headed hound of the underworld, with a mane of hissing serpents and a tail that ends in a viper's head. It welcomes the dead in, and lets nothing living back out.
tactics: Three heads bite three targets at once, its serpent-mane envenoms anyone who gets close, and it breathes hellfire across the gate.
habitat: the gates of the underworld, caves that lead too deep
weakness: Music lulls all three heads to sleep; honeyed cakes distract it

alternates.name: Serpent-Mane
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed (venom)

powers.name: Gate-Warden Senses
powers.detail: Darkvision, Scent, Tracking, Detect Living (the living who try to leave)

name: Scylla
summary: A nymph cursed into a horror: six dog-heads on long serpent necks rising from a cave above the strait, each with three rows of teeth. Every ship that passes loses six sailors.
tactics: Strikes from above with six long necks at once, snatching sailors off decks; she never leaves her cave, so ships that row hard can escape.
habitat: sea cliffs above a narrow strait
weakness: Anchored to her cave-rock: she cannot pursue beyond the reach of her necks

powers.name: Snatch from the Deck
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained

name: Charybdis
summary: A living whirlpool: an endless gullet at the bottom of the strait that swallows the sea three times a day and vomits it back up. Fleets vanish into her without a trace.
tactics: She does not chase; she simply drinks the sea, dragging every ship and swimmer for a mile into her spiral and down her throat.
habitat: the narrow strait opposite Scylla
weakness: She must breathe: three times a day she vomits the sea back up, the only safe window to pass

powers.name: Swallowing Maelstrom
powers.detail: Resisted by Strength; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained (drawn into the whirlpool)

powers.name: Sea-Born
powers.detail: Drowning, Deep Pressure, Cold, Suffocation, Water effects

name: Draugr
summary: A Viking corpse that still guards its grave-goods, swollen and blue-black, heavy as an ox. It swims through solid earth, swells to giant size, and its grip is the cold of the grave.
tactics: Rises up through the barrow floor behind intruders, swells huge, and crushes them; it can wear the shape of a grey seal or a flayed bull.
habitat: Norse burial mounds, frozen fjords, shipwreck graves
weakness: Iron scissors laid on its breast; beheaded, burned and its ashes scattered at sea

powers.name: Grave-Shapes
powers.detail: Grey seal, flayed bull or grey cat

name: Valkyrie
summary: A choosing-maiden of the battlefield in silver mail on a winged horse, who knows who will die today before the first blow falls. She carries the worthy dead to the hall of heroes.
tactics: Rides the sky above a battle, spears down the champion she has chosen, and blinds her enemies with the radiance of her armor.
habitat: battlefields, the sky road to the hall of heroes
weakness: Bound by oath: she cannot strike down one whom the Norns have not yet chosen

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: only carrying the slain to the hall of heroes

powers.name: Choosing Sight
powers.detail: Detect Mortality (sees who will die today), Extended Vision

name: World-Serpent Spawn
summary: A shed-off scrap of the serpent that circles the world, which still grows to swallow islands. It drools a venom so potent the sea steams where it falls.
tactics: Surfaces under ships, coils around the largest target, and sprays venom across the deck before sinking back into the deep.
habitat: deep oceans, northern seas, fjords
weakness: It must surface to breathe every hour; the hatchling-scales at its throat are soft

powers.name: World-Venom
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Incapacitated

name: Frost Jotun
summary: A giant of the ice-world, older than the gods, with a beard of icicles and a club carved from a glacier. Its breath freezes rivers mid-wave and men mid-scream.
tactics: Buries the field in Fimbul-winter, freezes the toughest foe solid, then shatters them with its glacier-club.
habitat: glaciers, frozen mountain halls, the ice-world
weakness: Fire and thunder; the jotun-kin swear oaths they cannot break, and can be tricked into them

powers.name: Rime Breath
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed (frozen solid)

name: Muspel Fire Jotun
summary: A giant from the burning world at the end of time, its skin cracked lava and its sword brighter than the sun. When enough of them cross the rainbow bridge, the world ends in fire.
tactics: Sweeps a line of flame across the battlefield with its sword, and anyone who closes in is burned by its body alone.
habitat: volcanoes, the burning world, the last battlefield
weakness: Cold iron quenched in a frost-river; drenching water staggers it

name: Chain-Breaker Wolf
summary: The wolf of the world's ending, whose jaws touch earth and sky when it opens them wide. Every chain ever forged has snapped on it, and it has sworn to swallow the sun.
tactics: Lunges to swallow the greatest threat whole, howls to break every army's nerve, and bursts any bond or prison laid on it.
habitat: a bound island in a black lake; anywhere it breaks free
weakness: A fetter woven from impossible things (a cat's footfall, a mountain's roots); a sword wedged in its jaws

powers.name: Swallow Whole
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained (swallowed)

powers.name: Ragnarok Howl
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (despair)

powers.name: Fetter-Bursting
powers.detail: Snares, bindings and imprisonment of every kind (except the silken fetter)

powers.name: Wolf Senses
powers.detail: Scent, Tracking, Low-light Vision, Acute Hearing

name: Flesh-Scarab Swarm
summary: A clicking black tide of tomb beetles that pours out of sarcophagi and burrows under skin. They strip a camel to bones in a minute.
tactics: Floods over a group in a gnawing carpet, burrows into the sand to avoid blows, and resurfaces somewhere worse.
habitat: tombs, sand dunes, museum basements
weakness: Fire and water scatter them; they never cross a line of burning oil

powers.name: Swarm Body
powers.detail: Grabs, trips and attacks against a single creature

name: Ammit the Devourer
summary: Crocodile-headed, lion-shouldered and hippo-hipped, she crouches beside the scales of judgment and eats the hearts that weigh more than a feather. The devoured do not get an afterlife.
tactics: Weighs the guilt of everyone present at a glance, crushes the guilty with the weight of their own deeds, and devours their hearts.
habitat: the Hall of Judgment, desecrated temples, the trials of the wicked
weakness: Powerless against the truly righteous: a heart lighter than the Feather of Truth cannot be devoured

powers.name: Weight of the Heart

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: only those with guilt on their hearts

powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (crushed by guilt)

name: Androsphinx of the Sands
summary: A man-headed lion the size of a war-elephant that has guarded the same tomb for four thousand years. It asks one riddle, and its roar can be heard in the next kingdom.
tactics: Poses its riddle; those who fail are blasted with a roar that shatters stone, then mauled as it unseals the magic of any spells cast in its presence.
habitat: tomb entrances, desert plateaus, lost temples
weakness: Bound by its riddle: answer correctly and it must let you pass unharmed

powers.name: Roar of the Sun
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated

powers.name: Riddle-Bond
powers.detail: Those who answer its riddle pass unharmed; it knows any lie told about its tomb

name: Apep, Serpent of Chaos
summary: The vast serpent of unmaking who waits each night in the underworld to swallow the sun. If it ever wins, there is no tomorrow. Eclipses are its near misses.
tactics: Paralyzes the strongest with its gaze of chaos, unravels whole armies with floods of venom, and swallows anything bright.
habitat: the underworld river, eclipses, the dark beneath the desert
weakness: Spells of banishment written with its name and burned; the sun's own champion can sever it each dawn

powers.name: Gaze of Unmaking
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed (gaze of chaos)

alternates.name: Unravel
alternates.detail: Any physical trait; resisted by Fortitude

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: unless slain by the sun itself

name: Kasa-Obake
summary: A paper umbrella that turned a hundred years old and came to life with one huge eye and a long, wet tongue. Mostly harmless, entirely unsettling.
tactics: Hops out of closets to lick and startle people, then flutters off on the wind cackling.
habitat: old storehouses, rainy alleys, temple closets
weakness: A grateful prayer of thanks for its years of service lays it to rest

name: Kappa
summary: A beaked, turtle-shelled river imp with a water-filled dish in its head and a terrible fondness for cucumbers and wrestling. It drowns horses and children for sport.
tactics: Challenges swimmers to sumo, grapples them and drags them under the river.
habitat: rivers, ponds, irrigation canals
weakness: Bow to it: it bows back, spills the water from its head-dish and loses all its strength

powers.name: Drowning Grapple
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (drowning)

name: Tengu
summary: A crow-winged, long-nosed mountain goblin in priest's robes and a master of the sword. Tengu train the worthy in secret arts and punish the arrogant, though they are terribly arrogant themselves.
tactics: Duels the best fighter present with blinding swordplay, blasts the rest off their feet with a gale from its feather fan, and vanishes on the mountain wind.
habitat: mountain forests, mountaintop shrines
weakness: Pride: a tengu cannot refuse a challenge to a duel, or a contest of skill

alternates.name: Feather-Fan Gale
alternates.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Prone (blown off their feet)

name: Jorogumo
summary: A spider that lived four hundred years and became a beautiful woman who plays the biwa by waterfalls. Men who follow the music are wrapped in silk and eaten slowly.
tactics: Lulls victims with music, binds them with silk thrown from the shadows, and bites with paralyzing venom; her spiderlings swarm anyone who interferes.
habitat: waterfalls, abandoned inns, deep forests
weakness: Fire burns her webs and her; she cannot lie about her true name if asked at a shrine

powers.name: Silk Snare
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained (silk)

alternates.name: Venom Bite
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Paralyzed

name: Nure-Onna
summary: A woman's head and shoulders on a three-hundred-foot serpent's body, waiting on the shoreline with a bundle she asks you to hold. The baby gets heavier, and heavier, and then she feeds.
tactics: Begs a passerby to hold her child, which becomes stone-heavy and pins them, then lashes out with her blood-drinking tongue and crushing coils.
habitat: rocky shores, riverbanks at dusk
weakness: Never take the bundle; she cannot leave the water's edge for long

alternates.name: Cursed Bundle
alternates.detail: Resisted by Strength; Hindered, Immobile, Restrained (the bundle turns heavy as stone)

name: Yuki-Onna
summary: The Snow Woman: pale, beautiful and silent, who appears in blizzards to travellers who will not live till morning. Her breath freezes the soul out of the body.
tactics: Hides in the storm, freezes victims with a breath, and beguiles the rest into lying down in the snow to sleep forever.
habitat: snowbound mountains, blizzards, frozen passes
weakness: Heat; and a promise: she spares those who swear never to speak of her, and kills them if they ever do

powers.name: Lie Down in the Snow
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Compelled, Asleep

alternates.name: Soul-Freezing Breath
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed (frozen)

name: Oni
summary: A red-skinned, horned ogre in a tiger-skin loincloth carrying an iron-studded club. Oni raid villages, drink sake by the barrel and drag sinners down to hell.
tactics: Smashes through the front door with its kanabo, beats thunder-drums to stun everyone in earshot, and laughs off wounds.
habitat: mountain fortresses, demon islands, the gates of hell
weakness: Roasted soybeans thrown while shouting drive it out; holly and sardine-heads ward doorways

powers.name: Thunder Drums
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (deafened)

name: Kitsune
summary: A nine-tailed fox spirit, a thousand years old, who has been a court lady, a priestess and a king's ruin. Her foxfire burns cold blue and her illusions fool every sense at once.
tactics: Never fights fair: she bewitches, deceives and confounds with illusion, and only burns her enemies with foxfire when they have truly earned it.
habitat: shrines, imperial courts, rice fields under the moon
weakness: Her star-ball holds her soul; dogs see through her disguises and she reverts when drunk

powers.name: Fox Senses
powers.detail: Mental Awareness, Scent, Low-light Vision, Detect Magic

name: Gashadokuro
summary: A skeleton fifteen times the height of a man, assembled from the bones of those who died of famine and were never buried. It hunts at night with a ringing in your ears as its only warning.
tactics: Approaches unseen until the ringing starts, plucks travellers off the road, and bites their heads off.
habitat: famine fields, old battlefields, mountain roads at 2 a.m.
weakness: Proper burial rites for its bones scatter it; Shinto purification wards repel it

powers.name: Ringing Ears
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (dread)

name: Jiangshi
summary: A stiff, hopping corpse in Qing-dynasty robes, green-skinned and arms outstretched, that drains the breath-qi of the living. It cannot see, but it can smell your breathing.
tactics: Hops toward the sound of breath in long, unnatural leaps and drains its victims' life-force with a cold touch.
habitat: graveyards, old inns, the long road home
weakness: A paper talisman on its forehead freezes it; hold your breath and it cannot find you; sticky rice and mirrors

name: Kelpie
summary: A sleek black horse grazing by the loch, saddled and waiting. Once you mount it, your hands stick to its hide, and it gallops straight into the deepest water.
tactics: Lures riders onto its back, where its adhesive hide traps them, then plunges into the loch; in human form it seduces travellers to the shore.
habitat: Scottish lochs, river fords, misty marshes
weakness: A bridle cast over its head binds it to the rider's service; cold iron

powers.name: Adhesive Hide
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile (stuck fast)

powers.name: Horse or Youth
powers.detail: Black horse or handsome youth with wet hair

name: Jersey Devil
summary: The thirteenth child of a cursed mother, born with a horse's head, bat wings, cloven hooves and a forked tail, which screamed and flew up the chimney. It has haunted the pine barrens for three centuries.
tactics: Shrieks from the treetops to scatter campers, then swoops on stragglers with claws and hooves.
habitat: pine barrens, swamps, back roads at night
weakness: Church bells drive it off; it fled a cannonball once and remembers

name: Bunyip
summary: A dark, shaggy, seal-headed thing that lives at the bottom of billabongs and swamps, booming in the night. People who wade in after dark are dragged down and never found.
tactics: Booms from the reeds to freeze prey with terror, then surges out of the murk to drag them under.
habitat: billabongs, swamps, creek-beds
weakness: Cannot leave its waterhole for long; it flees from fire

powers.name: Drag Under
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (drowning)

name: Mothman
summary: A seven-foot grey winged figure with huge glowing red eyes, seen on rooftops and bridges in the weeks before a disaster. Nobody agrees whether it causes catastrophe or tries to warn of it.
tactics: Appears to witnesses who freeze under its red stare, follows cars at impossible speeds, and only fights when cornered.
habitat: bridges, abandoned munitions plants, small river towns
weakness: Heeding its warning averts the disaster, and it departs

powers.name: Red Eyes
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed (dread-trance)

name: Naga Guardian
summary: A jewel-hooded serpent-being from beneath the rivers, who guards sacred treasures and the waters themselves. Wise and proud, it is a terrible enemy to those who poison its rivers.
tactics: Mesmerizes intruders with the swaying jewel of its hood, strikes with venom, and crushes the rest in its coils.
habitat: underwater palaces, temple tanks, sacred rivers
weakness: An honest oath binds it to help; it fears garuda feathers

powers.name: Venom Strike
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Incapacitated (venom)

powers.name: Hypnotic Hood
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

name: La Llorona
summary: The Weeping Woman in a soaked white dress who wanders riverbanks crying for the children she drowned. When her wail sounds far away, she is right behind you.
tactics: Wails to paralyze everyone with grief, glides along the water to the nearest child or lone wanderer, and drowns them in her embrace.
habitat: rivers, arroyos, canals at night
weakness: She cannot cross a threshold blessed with a mother's prayer; returning her children's bones to holy ground frees her

powers.name: Wail for My Children
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (grief)

alternates.name: Drowning Embrace
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (drowning)

name: Mokele-Mbembe
summary: The 'one who stops the flow of rivers': an elephant-sized, long-necked river beast of the Congo basin, rumored to be a living sauropod. It kills hippos and capsizes canoes that enter its waters.
tactics: Surges up under boats to capsize them and lashes intruders with its tail, then sinks out of sight.
habitat: Congo river basin, swamps, oxbow lakes
weakness: Strictly herbivorous and territorial: it calms if intruders retreat from its river

name: Qilin
summary: A scaled, dragon-headed, deer-bodied sacred beast that walks on clouds without bending the grass. It brings omens of great rulers, and burns the wicked with holy flame.
tactics: Gentle with the innocent, terrifying to the wicked: it scours evildoers with holy fire and gores them with its horn, then heals the wounded it was protecting.
habitat: sacred mountains, imperial gardens, the clouds
weakness: It will not harm the innocent even to save itself; a sincere oath binds it

name: Rakshasa
summary: A tiger-headed sorcerer-demon whose hands bend backwards at the wrist. It dines on human flesh, walks among people wearing borrowed faces, and spins illusions that fool every sense.
tactics: Infiltrates in disguise, turns enemies against each other with illusion, and curses from a distance; only in its true form does it rend with claws.
habitat: palaces, cremation grounds, forest ruins
weakness: Mirrors and still water show its true form; sacred syllables and blessed weapons wound it

alternates.name: Mind-Snare
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Compelled, Controlled

name: Garuda
summary: The golden eagle-king, sworn enemy of serpents, whose wingbeats stop rivers and darken the sky. Gods ride on its back; nagas flee at its shadow.
tactics: Blasts foes flat with hurricane wingbeats, then dives to seize the most dangerous one in its talons.
habitat: mountain peaks, the sky between worlds
weakness: Honor-bound: it will not strike one who has offered it shelter or bread

alternates.name: Downdraft
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (battered)

name: Banshee Queen
summary: The eldest of the keening women, who sings the deaths of royal lines. Her choir of lesser banshees follows her, and when all of them wail at once, the walls bleed.
tactics: Leads her choir in a death-keen that rips apart the living, foretells each hero's doom, and fades into mist before anyone can lay a hand on her.
habitat: ancestral castles, misty hills, royal crypts
weakness: A true heir of the house she mourns can command her silence

alternates.name: Wail of Doom
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (doom)

name: Thunderbird
summary: A sacred storm-being of many Indigenous traditions, whose wingbeats are thunder and whose eyes flash lightning. It fights the horned serpents of the deep and punishes those who violate the land and sky.
tactics: Strikes from the storm with lightning from its eyes, deafens with a thunderclap, and seizes monsters in its talons; it ignores those who show respect.
habitat: mountain peaks, thunderheads, the sky above great lakes
weakness: It acts only to punish wrongdoing: making true amends ends its storm

alternates.name: Thunderclap Wings
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (deafened)

name: Hag of the Chicken-Legged Hut
summary: The bony-legged forest witch with iron teeth, who flies in a mortar and sweeps her tracks with a broom. Her hut walks on giant chicken legs, its fence is topped with glowing skulls, and she is as likely to help you as eat you.
tactics: Tests visitors with impossible chores; the rude are hexed, aged to dust or turned into geese, while her hut stomps and pecks at anyone who attacks her.
habitat: the deep birch forest; a fence of skulls with glowing eyes
weakness: Guest-law: those who come with polite questions and a sincere task must be fed, not eaten; ask too many questions and the deal sours

powers.name: Hex of Ages
powers.detail: Strength, Stamina, Agility and Dexterity; resisted by Fortitude

alternates.name: Into a Goose
alternates.detail: People into geese, toads or stone
alternates.option: Broad group into one result, or one into a broad group
